about: What the attachment reader says. Each refusal code of read-data/attachment-read.mjs names its words here; the tool's answer carries them as said.
bad_attachment: Give the attachment as its row id (a whole number) or its guid (letters, digits, colon, underscore, dot or dash).
bad_options: Give as as original or jpeg, and most_px as a whole number from 64 to 4096.
messages_not_readable: The engine cannot read the Messages database on this Mac. Turn on Full Disk Access for the engine in System Settings, Privacy & Security, then ask again.
not_found: No attachment with that row id or guid is in the Messages database on this Mac.
not_on_this_mac: This attachment's file is not on this Mac. Messages keeps some attachments only in iCloud, or the file was removed.
outside_attachments: This attachment names a file outside the Messages attachments folder, so it is not read.
not_an_image: Only a picture can be answered as a JPEG. Ask for this attachment as original.
convert_failed: macOS could not make a JPEG from this picture.
too_big: This file is larger than one answer can carry. Ask again with as jpeg and a smaller most_px.
